meta.description: Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing parameters for shipboard deployment
notes: Primary use case: verification and pathogen typing when routine modalities flag ambiguous signals
Two deployment profiles: Flongle (rapid point-of-care) and MinION (deeper characterization)
Parameters grounded in ONT R10.4.1 chemistry with SUP basecalling (2024-2025 performance)
Sensitivity values assume metagenomic (untargeted) sequencing without enrichment

flongle_rapid.description: Flongle flow cell with rapid library prep. First result in <1 hour. Designed for single-sample verification at point of care.

accuracy.notes: Q20 = 99% accuracy per base; Q30 = 99.9%. Homopolymer errors dominate residual error.

turnaround.notes: full_run_hours is physical; the run's SimClock converts it to epochs. The former epoch_fraction assumed 1 epoch = 1 day and is dropped.

detection.notes: min_fraction_for_detection: target must be >0.01% of total reads for reliable detection without enrichment

costs.notes: Rapid prep (SQK-RAD114) requires minimal hands-on time. Labor is primarily monitoring.

minion_standard.description: MinION flow cell with ligation library prep. Deep characterization over 24-48h. For detailed outbreak genomics when time allows.

detection.notes: Higher depth enables detection at 0.005% abundance and SNP-level phylogenetics

costs.notes: Ligation prep (SQK-LSK114) gives longer reads but requires 2h hands-on. Flow cell can be washed and reused 1-2x.

simulation_parameters.description: Parameters for the simulation engine's LongReadNanoporeSequencing modality

detection_model.description: Multinomial sampling from the same compositional vector as short-read sequencing, but with different read depth and error characteristics

error_injection.notes: Error rates reflect post-SUP-basecalling residual errors on R10.4.1

classification.notes: Based on published Kraken2/WIMP benchmarks on ONT data

pathogen_calls.description: List of identified organisms with read counts and confidence

consensus_assembly.description: Whether sufficient depth exists for draft genome assembly

escalation_integration.description: How long-read results feed back into the decision engine

pathogen_confirmed.notes: Confirmed pathogen ID from long-read should set clinical mode to RED

amr_detected.notes: Adjusts treatment recommendations; may trigger enhanced decontamination

negative_verification.notes: If long-read finds no pathogen, can de-escalate a false alarm cheaply

wastewater_metagenomics.notes: Wastewater is bacteria-dominated; pathogen signal may be <0.1% of reads

clinical_specimen.notes: Host depletion critical for respiratory specimens; less needed for stool

clinical_culture.notes: Near-pure isolate; highest sensitivity for strain typing and AMR

surveillance_swab.notes: Mixed environmental sample; similar to short-read surface swab processing
